## What's free

Lite plans: Cloudant 1 GB, Db2 100 MB, API Connect 50k calls/month, Log Analysis 500 MB/day

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://www.ibm.com/cloud/free/> before relying on this.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
